newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: New Manila phone firms set up 130,407 lines in Q1.
newsitem.headline: New Manila phone firms set up 130,407 lines in Q1.

text.p: New entrants in the Philippine telephone industry had installed 130,407 new lines in the first quarter of the year, data released by the National Telecommunications Commission on Wednesday showed.
Total lines from the nine telephone companies reached 963,383 lines by the end of March, which was 25 percent of the 3.87 lines targetted by the end of the year.
Leading the group is ICC Telecoms, a subsidiary of Benpres Holdings Corp, as it complied fully with its commitment of 342,960 lines by the end of March, the data showed.
The other telephone firms include Pilipino Telephone Corp, Globe Telecom GMCR, and Digitel Telecommunications Phils Inc.
